sections.title: Classes, Constructors, Encapsulation and Inheritance
sections.scope: Class definitions, instance vs static fields, constructors (default, parameterized, copy), constructor chaining with this() and super(), encapsulation (private fields, public getters/setters), single/multilevel/hierarchical inheritance, and method overriding.

sections.title: Abstract Classes, Interfaces, Polymorphism and Modifiers (final, static, abstract)
sections.scope: Abstract classes and methods, interface definitions, implements keyword, multiple interface implementation, default and static interface methods (JDK 8), runtime polymorphism (dynamic method dispatch), and modifier rules (final classes/variables/methods, static methods and fields).

sections.title: ArrayList and Exception Handling
sections.scope: ArrayList operations (add, get, set, remove by index vs object, size, contains, isEmpty, generics), custom exceptions, checked vs unchecked exceptions, try-catch-finally control flow, multiple catch block hierarchy, and throw vs throws keywords.

sections.title: Swing GUI and Event Handling
sections.scope: Java Swing components (JFrame, JLabel, JTextField, JComboBox, JButton, JTextArea, JScrollPane, JOptionPane), Layout Managers (FlowLayout, BorderLayout, GridLayout), ActionListener interface and actionPerformed implementation, component registration with addActionListener, window lifecycle (setDefaultCloseOperation, pack, setVisible), input validation in GUI, and error dialogs.

sections.title: Arrays, 2D Arrays, Methods, Overloading, Recursion, Sorting and Searching
sections.scope: 1D and 2D arrays, matrix operations, static and instance methods, method overloading, recursion (base cases, call stack unwinding), linear and binary search algorithms, and iterative sorting (bubble, insertion, selection sort).

sections.title: OOP Class Design (Inheritance, Abstract Classes, Interfaces, Encapsulation)
sections.scope: Complete object-oriented program design covering encapsulation, single/multilevel/hierarchical/multiple/hybrid inheritance, abstract classes with abstract and concrete methods, interfaces with default methods, and dynamic method dispatch.

sections.title: Collections Framework, Custom Exceptions, and Advanced GUI Integration
sections.scope: Comprehensive practical programming questions on the Java Collections Framework (ArrayList, generics, custom comparators), hierarchical custom exception handling with file logging, and event-driven Swing graphical user interfaces with input validation.

sections.title: Predict-the-Output Code Tracing
sections.scope: Precise console output prediction for challenging Java code snippets testing initialization order, dynamic dispatch vs field hiding, compile-time overload resolution, String pool equality, try-catch-finally control flow, widening vs autoboxing, reference passing semantics, ArrayList removal variants, ragged arrays, and operator precedence.

sections.title: Debug & Extend Real-World Exam Scenarios
sections.scope: Multi-part capstone questions mirroring university exam debugging and programming problems. In Part 1, students analyze a buggy Java program, identifying exact line numbers, error types (syntax vs semantic), and specific fixes. In Part 2, students extend the corrected architecture with additional robust object-oriented capabilities, exception handling, and graphical user interface controls.
